title: Staging Gateway append-only runtime audit grant closure

phases.objective: Require only INSERT privilege on the Staging runtime audit_log table for durable Gateway transaction certification evidence, with repository grant-plan verification and unchanged Production bootstrap grants.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Compile the repository-owned Staging runtime grant policy and invoke the canonical role-grant plan without database writes.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The generated Staging runtime plan contains exactly one required audit_log entry with INSERT only; no schema-wide grants or Production, provider, or credential mutation are authorized.
steps: Resolve the Staging runtime required tables and per-table privilege operations, including audit_log.
Run the canonical staging-role-grant-plan.mjs --role runtime using the regression suite.
Reject grants on audit_log broader than INSERT, reject missing/optional audit evidence, and retain Production bootstrap and Governance role separation.
Require approved Staging-only database grant reconciliation and same-cycle readback independently after merge; block Gateway Certification until that happens.
assertions: Staging runtime audit_log is mandatory and receives exactly INSERT.
No SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE, GRANT OPTION, schema-wide privilege, or Production bootstrap role expansion is introduced by this change.
Canonical grant-plan output is checked, not only an in-memory policy object.
No database or provider mutation, secret material, certification, or release is performed by this PR.
Staging operational grant apply requires independent authority and post-apply evidence before any new Gateway certification.
